## How REST writes FLOAT64 cells
# Sources: BigQuery's answers to unverified cases.

SELECT CAST(1e-4 AS FLOAT64)
=> "1.0E-4"

SELECT CAST(0.001 AS FLOAT64)
=> "0.001"

SELECT CAST(1e300 AS FLOAT64)
=> "1.0E300"

SELECT CAST(-12345678.5 AS FLOAT64)
=> "-1.23456785E7"

SELECT CAST(9999999.5 AS FLOAT64)
=> "9999999.5"

SELECT CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)
=> "Infinity"

SELECT CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64)
=> "-Infinity"

SELECT CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64)
=> "NaN"

SELECT CAST(-0.0 AS FLOAT64)
=> "-0.0"

SELECT [CAST(1e10 AS FLOAT64)]
=> [{"v":"1.0E10"}]

SELECT CAST(9007199254740992 AS FLOAT64)
=> "9.007199254740992E15"

SELECT CAST(1e-3 AS FLOAT64) * 0.999
=> "9.99E-4"
